info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Pharmacy Prescriptions Refill-v3-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Refill API facilitates the process of initiating refills for existing medication prescriptions. This endpoint allows healthcare providers and pharmacy systems to efficiently manage patient medication continuations by submitting refill requests. Typically used by pharmacists and healthcare professionals, this API streamlines operations and ensures timely access to necessary medications for patients. It supports compliance with prescription management processes, improving patient adherence and safety in medication administration.

post.description: This API endpoint allows you to request a refill for a specific prescription. Ensure that the prescription is eligible for a refill and that you provide all necessary information.

requestBody.description: A request to refill a prescription. The body must specify the necessary details for the prescription refill operation, including identification of the prescription and the patient.

200.description: Request completed successfully, the prescription refill has been processed.

CreatePharmacyPrescriptionsRefillRequest.title: Prescription Refill Request

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the refill request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the prescription.

customer.description: Details about the customer requesting the refill.

resource.description: The resource associated with the prescription (e.g., medication name).

priority.description: The priority level of the refill request.

amount.description: The amount of medication requested for refill.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether notification is required once the refill is processed.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp at which the refill request was made.

channel.description: The communication channel through which the refill request was made.

recordIndex.description: An index to identify the record for processing.

CreatePharmacyPrescriptionsRefillRequest.description: Schema representing a request for a prescription refill operation.
